items.raw: 'The market is in panic. Extreme fear like this has historically marked capitulation zones - most people are selling in fear. Contrarians start paying attention here.'
items.en: The market is in panic. Extreme fear like this has historically marked capitulation zones - most people are selling in fear. Contrarians start paying attention here.
items.es: El mercado está en pánico. Un miedo extremo como este ha marcado históricamente zonas de capitulación - la mayoría está vendiendo por miedo. Aquí es donde los contrarians empiezan a prestar atención.

items.raw: 'Fear is in charge. Sentiment is weak and positioning is defensive - moves down feel bigger than they are. Watch for stabilization.'
items.en: Fear is in charge. Sentiment is weak and positioning is defensive - moves down feel bigger than they are. Watch for stabilization.
items.es: El miedo manda. El sentimiento está débil y el posicionamiento es defensivo - las bajadas se sienten más grandes de lo que son. Vigila si aparece una estabilización.

items.raw: 'The market is undecided. Neither fear nor greed dominates - trends born here need confirmation from volume and momentum.'
items.en: The market is undecided. Neither fear nor greed dominates - trends born here need confirmation from volume and momentum.
items.es: El mercado está indeciso. Ni el miedo ni la codicia dominan - las tendencias que nacen aquí necesitan confirmación de volumen y momentum.

items.raw: 'Greed is building. Momentum-chasing is on; dips get bought fast. Enjoy it, but this is where discipline starts paying.'
items.en: Greed is building. Momentum-chasing is on; dips get bought fast. Enjoy it, but this is where discipline starts paying.
items.es: La codicia va en aumento. Se persigue el momentum; las caídas se compran rápido. Disfrútalo, pero aquí es donde la disciplina empieza a dar frutos.

items.raw: 'Euphoria. Everyone is greedy, leverage is stacked and "this time is different" is trending. Historically the zone where pullbacks are born.'
items.en: Euphoria. Everyone is greedy, leverage is stacked and "this time is different" is trending. Historically the zone where pullbacks are born.
items.es: Euforia. Todo el mundo es codicioso, el apalancamiento se acumula y "esta vez es diferente" está de moda. Históricamente, la zona donde nacen las correcciones.
